document.title: BRS-161014DT Test VP lot change point + VP #7/#9 center dome +0.05mm

primary_defect.canonical_name: NG VP bending / VP cutting not all / VP cutting burr

document.purpose: Verify VP bending, cutting-not-all and cutting-burr after laser cutting on VP lot change point and on VP mold #7/#9 center-dome +0.05mm condition.
content: Check NG bending/cutting-not-all/cutting-burr after laser cutting on molds #2/#4/#6/#7/#9/#10
Sheet1 compares 1Hr vs 2Hr at 150°C dry molds #2/4/6/8/10 vs Normal

conclusions.topic: Lot VP change point - laser cutting NG
conclusions.statement_from_report: Mold #2/4/6/10 Lot VP change point laser NG 0.8-3.8%.
conclusions.normalized_interpretation: Mold #2 0.8%, #4 1.4%, #6 1.0%, #10 3.8%. Mold #10 is highest. No same-event Normal in sheet 21.6 vision block; classified as ng_without_baseline ranking - all below 5%.
Center dome +0.05mm severely worsens VP bending (mold #7 46.3% bending, mold #9 cutting burr+not-all dominant). Relative to lot change point molds (0.8-3.8%), the +0.05mm condition is ~5-50x worse.

1Hr vs Normal: 3.75 / 2.67 = 1.404x, 40.4% worse. 2Hr vs Normal: 3.89 / 2.67 = 1.456x, 45.6% worse. Both dry conditions in sheet1 trial are worse than baseline; 1Hr vs 2Hr difference is small (3.7% relative).

suggested_checks.check_item: Reject center dome +0.05mm spec for molds #7/#9
suggested_checks.reason: Mold #7 laser NG 40% (bending 46%), Mold #9 14.6% - far above the 0.8-3.8% baseline of lot-change-point molds.
Mold #10 NG 3.8% is highest among the 4 lot-change molds.

suggested_checks.check_item: Do not switch to 1Hr or 2Hr at 150°C dry (Sheet1)
suggested_checks.reason: Both 1Hr and 2Hr at 150°C are 40-46% worse than Normal.

limitations: Sheet 21.6 has no in-sheet Normal for laser cutting block.

assumptions: Compared 1Hr/2Hr Sheet1 totals against Sheet1 Normal row (12100pcs).
warnings: Vision NG block has no Normal row - used ng_without_baseline ranking inside the same block.
ai_extraction_log.decision_rationale: Center dome +0.05mm severely degrades VP bending in laser cutting. Function differences are small. Sheet1 shows both 1Hr/2Hr drying conditions are worse than Normal.
